description: This file is a C++ source code implementing a module for handling a data model XML, including functions for loading, parsing, and querying parameter data, with focus on device parameters and instance handling.

methods.name: loadDataModel
methods.description: Loads the XML data model from a file into memory, initializing the database handle.

methods.name: checkDataModelStatus
methods.description: Checks if the data model has been successfully loaded.

methods.name: getDataModelHandle
methods.description: Returns the handle to the loaded XML data model.

methods.name: getChildParamNamesFromDataModel
methods.description: Retrieves parameter names and data types matching a wildcard pattern from the data model.

methods.name: get_complete_param_list
methods.description: Returns the complete list of parameters and their data types from the data model.

methods.name: freeDataModelParam
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a DataModelParam structure.

methods.name: test_get_complete_param_list
methods.description: Test function to verify retrieval of complete parameter list and parameter info.
